{
  "dataset_name": "loan_status",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "loan_to_income_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Loan amount as a fraction of annual income, capped to avoid extreme outliers. Higher values indicate greater repayment burden.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "affordability_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous severity measure useful for linear margin separation of risky vs safe loans.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(loan_amnt / np.maximum(person_income, 1.0), 0.0, 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_income",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed personal income to compress heavy right tail and provide an approximately linear projection.",
      "value_range": [8.0, 16.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes skewed income distribution, improving SVM margin scaling.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.clip(person_income, 0.0, 10000000.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_loan_amount",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed loan amount to compress its right tail.",
      "value_range": [5.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides smoother input scale for linear projections.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.clip(loan_amnt, 0.0, 100000.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_score_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Credit score scaled to [0,1] using observed range bounds.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized smooth severity score ideal for linear SVM weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((credit_score - 300.0) / 550.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "interest_rate_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interest rate scaled into approximate [0,1] using plausible bounds.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalized_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth continuous risk proxy; higher rates often correlate with risk.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((loan_int_rate - 5.0) / 20.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "previous_default_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator of prior default presence on file.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_flag",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Strong linear-separable signal for repayment behavior.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(previous_loan_defaults_on_file == 'Yes', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_to_age_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Employment experience as a fraction of adult years (age minus 18), capped at 1.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "stability_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth stability indicator; captures career maturity for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(person_emp_exp / np.maximum(person_age - 18.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_history_to_age_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Credit history length divided by adult years, indicating financial track record depth.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "stability_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth proxy for credit maturity, beneficial for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(cb_person_cred_hist_length / np.maximum(person_age - 18.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "interest_burden_weighted",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite of loan-to-income times interest rate, approximating annual interest cost relative to income.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.5],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Multiplicative risk composite useful as a linear margin feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((loan_amnt / np.maximum(person_income, 1.0)) * (loan_int_rate / 100.0), 0.0, 0.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "renter_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that the borrower rents their home, a common risk-associated tenure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_flag",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Discrete tenure signal contributing linearly to risk margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(person_home_ownership == 'RENT', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "education_attainment_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal mapping of education level reflecting attainment: High School=0.25, Associate=0.4, Bachelor=0.6, Master=0.8, Doctorate=1.0. Captures monotonic socioeconomic ordering.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous ordinal projection of education suitable for linear weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(person_education == 'Doctorate', 1.0, np.where(person_education == 'Master', 0.8, np.where(person_education == 'Bachelor', 0.6, np.where(person_education == 'Associate', 0.4, np.where(person_education == 'High School', 0.25, 0.3)))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "loan_intent_risk_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic ordering of loan purpose by typical financial-stress association: DEBTCONSOLIDATION=0.9, MEDICAL=0.8, HOMEIMPROVEMENT=0.5, PERSONAL=0.5, EDUCATION=0.4, VENTURE=0.6. Reflects domain judgment about purpose-driven risk severity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_risk_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes categorical intent as smooth continuous severity for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(loan_intent == 'DEBTCONSOLIDATION', 0.9, np.where(loan_intent == 'MEDICAL', 0.8, np.where(loan_intent == 'VENTURE', 0.6, np.where(loan_intent == 'HOMEIMPROVEMENT', 0.5, np.where(loan_intent == 'PERSONAL', 0.5, np.where(loan_intent == 'EDUCATION', 0.4, 0.5))))))"
    }
  ]
}
